InsufficientCredits.description:
Your team does not have enough credits for this render.

Codes: `INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS`, `INSUFFICIENT_DATA_CREDITS`.

RenderBadRequest.description:
Invalid JSON, failed validation, or an unpublished campaign.

- `INVALID_JSON` — body is not valid JSON
- `VALIDATION_ERROR` — schema validation failed; `details` maps field names to error messages
- `NOT_PUBLISHED` — the campaign template is not published

RenderUpstreamError.description:
The render service could not be reached or failed to accept the job. Any credits deducted for the request are automatically refunded.

Codes: `RENDER_FAILED`, `RENDER_ERROR`, `REALTIME_RENDER_FAILED`.

Unauthorized.description:
Missing, invalid, or expired credential.

Codes: `MISSING_API_KEY`, `INVALID_API_KEY`, `EXPIRED_API_KEY`, `AUTH_FAILED`.

details.description: For `VALIDATION_ERROR`: maps each invalid field name to an array of error messages.

allow_missing_fields.description: By default the batch is rejected if any campaign field has no matching CSV column. Set to `true` to let such fields fall back to their campaign default values instead. A field with neither a column nor a non-empty default still rejects the batch.

isSmartField.description: True when Tailor fills this field automatically at render time. Provide a value to override it.

key.description: Stable field key. Use it as the property name in the `fields` object of render requests, and as the CSV column header for batch renders.

campaign_id.description: The campaign this dataset belongs to.

content_type.description: Content type of the upcoming upload. Defaults to `text/csv`.

fields.description: The video's resolved field values. Present only when `include_fields=true`.

video_id.description: The `video_id` you supplied (or the value of `video_id_column` for dataset batches).

FieldValues.description: Field values for a render, keyed by field key. Values may be strings or numbers; nested objects are not allowed. Omitted fields fall back to their campaign defaults (and smart fields are filled automatically).

campaign_id.description: `null` when the subscription covers all campaigns.

completion_webhook_url.description: Optional URL that receives one signed `batch.completed` or `batch.failed` event when the whole batch finishes.

Fields backed by an active smart field are omitted by default because Tailor fills them automatically at render time — pass `include_smart_fields=true` to see them (any value you provide for a smart field at render time overrides the automatic one).

post.description:
Creates a dataset and returns the URL to upload its CSV to. The full flow is:

1. `POST /datasets` → returns `upload_url`
2. `PUT` the raw CSV bytes to `upload_url` (with your normal auth header)
3. `POST /datasets/{id}/complete` to start processing
4. Poll `GET /datasets/{id}` until `status` is `ready`
5. Start a batch with `POST /render/batch`

r2_key.description: Internal storage key of the upload.

upload_url.description: URL to `PUT` the CSV to. Include your auth header on the upload request — this is a Tailor API endpoint, not a presigned storage URL.

201.description: Dataset created; upload the CSV next.

get.description: Returns a dataset's processing status and, once processed, its detected columns. Before launching a batch, confirm each `columns[].name` exactly matches the key of the campaign field it should fill.

post.description: Marks the upload finished and starts processing: the CSV is parsed, columns are detected, and the dataset moves to status `ready`. Poll `GET /datasets/{id}` to follow progress. No request body.

error.message: No upload found — PUT the CSV to /upload first

400.description: No CSV has been uploaded yet.

put.description: Uploads the dataset's raw CSV. Send the file bytes directly as the request body — not as JSON and not as multipart form data — and include your normal auth header. After a successful upload, call `POST /datasets/{id}/complete`.

error.message: Upload key not set — create the dataset first

400.description: The dataset has no upload key yet — create the dataset first.

post.description:
Subscribes a URL to an event type. Tailor will `POST` a signed JSON payload to `target_url` every time the event occurs — see the [Webhooks guide](/api-reference/webhooks) for payload shapes and signature verification.

`target_url` must be a public `https://` (or `http://`) URL; URLs that resolve to private or internal addresses are rejected.

error.message: URLs to private/internal IP addresses are not allowed

400.description:
Invalid JSON, failed validation, or a disallowed `target_url`.

- `INVALID_JSON` — body is not valid JSON
- `VALIDATION_ERROR` — schema validation failed (`details` maps field names to error messages)
- `INVALID_TARGET_URL` — the URL is unsupported or resolves to a private/internal address

error.message: Campaign not found or access denied

404.description: The `campaign_id` filter does not match a campaign on your team.

post.description: Starts an asynchronous MP4 render of one video. Returns `202 Accepted` immediately; poll `poll_url` or pass `completion_webhook_url` to be notified when the video is ready.

id.description: ID of the render. Use it with the status endpoint.

video_id.description: The `video_id` you supplied, or the render ID when omitted.

post.description:
Renders one video per row of an uploaded dataset. The dataset must belong to the campaign and have status `ready`.

Columns are mapped to campaign fields by exact name match: a CSV column named `lead_name` fills the field with key `lead_name`. Use `GET /datasets/{id}` to confirm your column names before launching.

Only one batch per dataset can be in flight at a time — a second launch while one is rendering returns `409 BATCH_ALREADY_RENDERING`.

error.message: CSV has no column for required field(s): lead_name, property_address. Rename your CSV headers to exactly match these field keys, or set allow_missing_fields to fall back to defaults.

400.description:
Invalid JSON, failed validation, or unmapped fields.

- `INVALID_JSON` — body is not valid JSON
- `VALIDATION_ERROR` — schema validation failed (`details` maps field names to error messages)
- `NOT_PUBLISHED` — the campaign template is not published
- `UNMAPPED_FIELDS` — the CSV has no column for one or more required fields (the missing keys are listed in `fields`)
- `MISSING_FIELDS_NO_DEFAULT` — with `allow_missing_fields`, one or more fields have neither a CSV column nor a default value (listed in `fields`)

error.message: Dataset not found, not ready, or does not belong to campaign

404.description:
Campaign or dataset not found.

- `CAMPAIGN_NOT_FOUND` — campaign not found or access denied
- `DATASET_NOT_FOUND` — dataset not found, not `ready`, or does not belong to the campaign

error.message: A batch render for this dataset is already in progress (batch b7f2…). Cancel it or wait for it to finish before starting another.

409.description:
The campaign is paused, or a batch for this dataset is already rendering.

- `CAMPAIGN_PAUSED` — resume the campaign to start new renders
- `BATCH_ALREADY_RENDERING` — the in-flight batch's ID is returned as `batch_id`

post.summary: Start a batch render from a dataset

post.description: Renders up to 500 videos from field values supplied directly in the request — no dataset upload required. For larger jobs, upload a dataset and use `POST /render/batch`.

Starts a realtime (HLS streaming) render. The response includes an HLS `playlist_url` that starts playing while the video is still being produced. The same URL is also returned as `video_url` by the status endpoint once the stream is live.

id.description: ID of the render. Use it with the status endpoint.

playlist_url.description: HLS playlist (`.m3u8`) URL for the stream.

post.description: Requests cancellation of an in-flight batch. Cancellation is cooperative: videos already rendering finish or stop shortly after, queued work is dropped, and the batch finalizes with status `cancelled`. Only batches currently in status `rendering` can be cancelled.

error.message: Batch is completed and cannot be cancelled

409.description: The batch is not in a cancellable state (only `rendering` batches can be cancelled).

get.description:
Polls a render by ID. The ID may be a single render ID (from `POST /render` or `POST /render/realtime`) or a batch ID (from `POST /render/batch` or `POST /render/inline-batch`) — the response's `type` field tells you which it was.

For per-video results of a batch, use `GET /render/{id}/deliverables`.

parameters.description: A render ID or batch ID.
parameters.name: id
